Backend Engineer, GreenGrid — Sep 2024 - Present
Built and maintained REST APIs for energy consumption telemetry and billing ingestion using FastAPI and Flask; designed endpoints consumed by mobile and web clients. Implemented authentication and rate-limiting middleware, optimized PostgreSQL queries to reduce average response latency by 35%. Containerized services for local development and CI using Docker and documented API contracts in Confluence. Integrated background jobs with Celery to process meter data batches and deployed services to AWS with IaC patterns. Used Linux-based tooling and Jira for sprint planning and issue tracking.

Software Engineer - Backend, Ola — Nov 2020 - Aug 2024
Developed microservices in Flask and Django to support ride-matching and payment workflows; exposed REST APIs consumed by internal services and mobile apps. Led migration of monolithic billing worker to Celery-based distributed tasks, improving throughput by 4x. Designed database schemas and optimized PostgreSQL indices to cut query time for trip aggregation reports by 60%. Packaged services in Docker for CI/CD pipelines and managed deployments to AWS. Authored technical runbooks in Confluence and coordinated releases via Jira on Linux-based production instances.

Skills: Python 3, Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, REST APIs, Docker, Celery, Flask, Confluence, Linux, Jira

Education: CA, ICAI
